start.title: [TODO:it] Night Crossing
start.text:
[TODO:it] The boat drifts under the moon.
The wind begins to rise.

sleep_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Stay Awake
sleep_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] The sea will not wait.
Grip an oar.

turnback_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Cross As He Said
turnback_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] He told you to cross.
Keep going.

wind.title: [TODO:it] Wind Against You
wind.text:
[TODO:it] Wind tears the sail.
Waves slam the hull.

curse_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Hold Fast
curse_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Cursing stills no sea.
Row with them.

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Stand With Them
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Your brothers need your hands.
Rise.

ghost.title: [TODO:it] A Figure on the Sea
ghost.text:
[TODO:it] Someone walks on the water.
The disciples cry, "A ghost!"

scream_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Look Again
scream_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Fear will blind you.
Lift your eyes.

reassure.title: [TODO:it] Take Courage
reassure.text:
[TODO:it] His voice carries on the wind.
"Take heart. It is I."

doubt_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Trust His Voice
doubt_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] It is the Lord.
Ask him.

silent_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Speak To Him
silent_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Silence holds you back.
Call to him.

peter_step.title: [TODO:it] Out of the Boat
peter_step.text:
[TODO:it] Your foot hovers above the wave.
Will you trust?

stay_consequence.title: [TODO:it] Answer the Call
stay_consequence.text:
[TODO:it] Faith is on the water.
Step out.

peter_sink.title: [TODO:it] The Wind, the Waves
peter_sink.text:
[TODO:it] You see the wind.
Fear pulls you down.

swim_consequence.title: Chiamalo
swim_consequence.text:
La tua forza viene meno.
Lui ti sta raggiungendo.

curse_self_consequence.title: Guarda a Lui
curse_self_consequence.text:
La vergogna non ti solleverà.
Allunga la mano.

calm.title: Veramente il Figlio di Dio
calm.text:
Sale sulla barca.
Il vento si placa.
